label: Chapter 94
english: On one occasion I visited the holy father Macarius at the full heat of midday, and I asked for some water to drink as I was burning with thirst, and he said, ‘Let the shade suffice, for there are many people at this very moment traveling or sailing who are deprived even of this.’ Then, when I repeated to him some sayings concerning self-control, he said, ‘Take courage, o child: for twenty years I have never taken as much as I wanted wanted of bread, water or sleep. I ate my bread by weight, drank water by measure, and snatched a little bit of sleep reclining against a wall’.
